app.subtitle: High School Entrance Interview Practice for Foreign Junior High Students

mode_select.title: Select Mode
mode_select.practice_desc: A Q&A practice mode. You can get advice from Professor Owl after each response.
mode_select.real_desc: Answer 5 questions non-stop, just like a real exam. No intermediate advice is provided.
mode_select.vocab_desc: Check the meanings and readings of important words and phrases frequently used in interviews.
mode_select.ordering_desc: Learn Japanese interview manners by putting them in the correct order.

ordering.title: Behavior Ordering Mode
ordering.lead: Select a card from above and place it in the correct order in slots 1 to 4 below.
ordering.alert_fill_all: Please place cards in all slots.
ordering.incorrect_msg: Let's try again. The order seems incorrect.
